title: Lacson rejects Cayetanos’ ‘selective justice’ claim amid Taguig probe

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Panfilo “Ping” Lacson on Saturday rejected insinuations of “selective justice” and “intimidation” made by Sens. Alan Peter Cayetano and Pia Cayetano amid an ongoing feud involving alleged anomalous government projects in Taguig City. Lacson made the pronouncement after Cayetano dared him to probe other areas instead of focusing on Taguig City,
